three-ws.note: three.ws 3D studio over MCP. Catalog search, docs search and model rendering are free with no account. Making, refining or rigging a model needs a free three.ws account: Grok Build opens the three.ws sign-in in your browser on first connect. Tools: text or image to a textured GLB, a rigged avatar, auto-rigging, refinement, render checks, job polling, catalog search and personas. No tool on this server moves money.
